vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --stats_text --quiet --force_overwrite --mask_header_cache_path --dir_plugins {plugins} --plugin LoF,loftee_path:{plugins},human_ancestor_fa:{corpus}/plugin_data/human_ancestor.fa.gz,gerp_bigwig:{corpus}/plugin_data/gerp_conservation_scores.homo_sapiens.GRCh38.bw,conservation_file:{corpus}/plugin_data/loftee.synthetic.sql [--tab|--vcf|--json]
input: the records of the corpus GRCh38-plugin-loftee, its variants.vcf byte for byte: 24 ClinVar records on chromosome 21 (public ClinVar identifiers; INFO dropped) chosen from a LoFTEE run over the whole chromosome so that every verdict class the plugin writes appears at least once, plus one constructed record (nagnag_acceptor, the A of a JAM2 acceptor AG that a second AG follows three bases on) whose NAGNAG_SITE motif ends the 9-base context the plugin reads, where the ClinVar NAGNAG_SITE record's motif opens it: high-confidence stop-gained, frameshift, splice-donor and splice-acceptor calls; the END_TRUNC, 5UTR_SPLICE, 3UTR_SPLICE and GC_TO_GT_DONOR filters, alone and beside high-confidence rows of the same record; the SINGLE_EXON, NON_CAN_SPLICE, NAGNAG_SITE and NO_EXON_NUMBER flags; two records whose loss-of-function consequence carries no exon number; and a missense and a synonymous record the plugin leaves alone. No record's loss-of-function allele is the ancestral base, and no END_TRUNC decision lies within 40 GERP units of the -58 cutoff.
plugin_source: LoF.pm and the files it loads, of the LOFTEE repository (https://github.com/konradjk/loftee) at its grch38 branch, commit a46b502a68c812c8ae0c5a5721c0603fe81cae8d (tag v1.0.4_GRCh38), mounted as --dir_plugins and named by loftee_path through {plugins}; its maxEntScan directory holds the stand-in files scripts/data/write_loftee_stand_ins.py writes
generator: variants.vcf, json_cache, the reference with its indexes and, under plugin_data, the ancestral-allele FASTA with its indexes and the GERP bigWig are the files of the corpus GRCh38-plugin-loftee, byte for byte, cut as that corpus's record says (the record under plugin_fixtures is that corpus's); scripts/fixtures/loftee_conservation_database.py --branch grch38 --name loftee.synthetic.sql --seed 1 --dir plugin_data (the synthetic SQLite database the grch38 branch opens under conservation_file, LoF.pm line 126: a fabricated row an exon of the cached protein-coding transcripts in the phylocsf_summary table that branch queries, with some exons left without one, and in the phylocsf_data and gerp_exons tables of the master branch, which the grch38 branch does not read, each value a function of the seed, the table, the transcript's stable id and the exon number; seed, row counts and digest under plugin_fixtures); scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus --dir-plugins <loftee checkout> (the manifest's run, Ensembl VEP's LoF plugin at the grch38 branch of its repository reading loftee_path and --dir_plugins through {plugins}); tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 116 --assembly GRCh38 --dataset loftee=<reference>=<variants.vcf> --k 100 --seed 1 --keep-records --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --flag=... --fasta-name reference.fa.gz (on a manifest that names LoFTEE under covers and the plugin's files under plugin_files; every record kept) and classify --field LoF --field LoF_filter --field LoF_flags --field LoF_info
reference: a conservation_file other than false is opened as a SQLite database (LoF.pm line 126 of the grch38 branch), here the synthetic one under plugin_fixtures, and every stop-gained or frameshift row of a protein-coding transcript that has an exon number is looked up in its phylocsf_summary table by the transcript's stable id and the exon number (LoF.pm lines 262, 274-275 and 553-557). Of the 56 such rows, 10 find no row and gain PHYLOCSF_TOO_SHORT in LoF_info; 46 gain ANN_ORF and MAX_ORF there, 10 of them under a non-negative annotated score, 17 with the flag PHYLOCSF_UNLIKELY_ORF and 19 with PHYLOCSF_WEAK (LoF.pm lines 276-284), among them scores of exactly 0 and two rows that carry SINGLE_EXON beside their flag. Every other field of every row is what the manifest's run of the corpus GRCh38-plugin-loftee writes, which reads no database: the grch38 branch takes every interval of a GERP walk from the bigWig (gerp_dist.pl lines 58-63), so no row reads the gerp_exons table, and none reads the phylocsf_data table, whose rows differ from those of phylocsf_summary on 54 of the 56 lookups. The reference image carries no samtools, so the plugin's ancestral-allele read returns nothing there, as in that corpus's run, and the warnings file of each format holds that read's warning alone (LoF.pm line 540, 128 lines); expected/ holds no warnings log, as that corpus's holds none
